settings.presenceMessageHintDnd: Your calls go to your forward (all calls, else no answer, else busy); without one, they are refused and the caller reads this message.

settings.presenceUntilInvalid: The end date must be in the future, less than a year away.

settings.forwardNotExtension: Only a colleague's extension can receive your calls for now (no outside number yet).
settings.forwardDelayInvalid: The delay is a whole number from 5 to 120 seconds.

admin.conflictReserved: {userId}: {extension} is an emergency number or another short number of the French plan, which goes to the operator when dialled; give another extension in the directory
admin.groupsHelp: A group has a number of its own: a call to it rings its members at once (12 at most, one window of each first), and the first to answer takes the call. Members in "do not disturb" do not ring, and their personal forwards do not apply. A vacated extension stays a member: it rings again as soon as someone holds it.
admin.groupsUnavailable: This telephony platform does not handle ring groups.
admin.groupsLoadError: The groups could not be loaded.
admin.groupMembersHint: The extensions to ring, separated by commas (for example 101, 102, 103).

admin.groupDeleteError: The group could not be deleted.
admin.groupNumberInvalid: This number is not valid: digits and letters, no spaces.
admin.groupNumberTaken: This number is already taken (an extension, or a number reserved elsewhere): choose a free number.
admin.groupNumberReserved: This is an emergency number or another short number of the French plan: dialled, it goes to the operator. Choose another number.
admin.groupExists: A group of your organisation already has this number: edit it from the list, or choose another number.
admin.groupNameInvalid: The name must be one line of 1 to 64 characters.
admin.groupMemberNotExtension: Only extensions of your organisation can be members of a group.
admin.groupSyncRunning: A synchronisation of the directory is running: try again in a moment.
